translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Angʼo momiyo ichungʼ gichien, yaye Jehova Nyasaye?
Angʼo momiyo ipondo ne ji e ndalo mag chandruok?
Ngʼat ma timbene richo goyo apedha ni joma onge nyalo
kendo omakogi e otegu mage mosechiko.
Dwache maricho mopando e chunye omiyo osungore;
jowuoche ema ogwedho to Jehova Nyasaye to ochayo.
Sunga omake ma ok onyal manye;
onge thuolo kata matin mochiwo ne Nyasaye e chunye.
Yorene dhi maber kinde duto,
okawore omiyo chikeni ni mabor moyombe;
ojaro wasike duto.
Owacho ne en owuon niya, “Onge gima nyalo yienga;
abiro dak gi kwe kinde duto kaonge gima thaga.”
Dhoge opongʼ gi miriambo kod weche mag kwongʼ;
chandruok gi weche maricho ni e bwo lewe.
Okiyo ji e bath yore mag gwengʼ,
onego ji apoya koa kuonde moponde,
osiko ongʼicho mondo wangʼe omaki joma onge ketho mondo ohiny.
Okiyo ji kokichore ka sibuor mopondo;
okichore mar mako joma ok nyal mondo ohinygi,
omako joma ok nyal kendo oywayogi oko gi tonde mar meko.
Joma hapgi rach momako otieko kendo podho chuth,
gipodho e bwo tekone.
Owachone en owuon niya, “Nyasaye wiye osewil;
opando wangʼe kendo onge gima oneno.”
Aa malo yaye Jehova Nyasaye!
Tingʼ badi malo, yaye Nyasaye.
Kik wiyi wil gi joma ok nyal.
Angʼo momiyo ngʼama timbene richo jaro Nyasaye?
Angʼo momiyo owacho e chunye ni,
“Ok obi keta piny mopenja gima asetimo?”
To in, yaye Nyasaye, ineno chandruok gi kuyo,
ikawogi kaka mari kendo itingʼogi e lweti.
Ngʼat ma ok nyal; chiwore ne in;
in e jakony mar joma onge wuonegi.
Tur bad ngʼama rach ma timbene richo;
luonge mondo onyis ji gik maricho mosetimo lingʼ-lingʼ,
ma ji ok nyal fwenyo mi ngʼe.
Jehova Nyasaye en Ruoth mochwere manyaka chiengʼ;
ogendini biro lal nono e pinye.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, in iwinjo kwayo mar joma chandore;
ijiwogi, kendo ichiko iti ni ywakgi,
Ichwako nyithi kiye kod joma isando,
mondo dhano ma ochwe gi lowo,
kik dhi nyime gi bwogo ji.
